summary: Learn to map, govern, and audit digital tender workflows using practical controls and data checks. Explore the course and plan your training.
lede: E-government procurement training helps procurement, finance, tender committee, and ICT staff improve digital workflows. Participants map supplier registration and tender processes, assess bid-evaluation and award controls, and review audit trails and procurement data quality in Excel. The syllabus also covers BPMN process mapping, Open Contracting Data Standard records, and operational awareness of AI-assisted anomaly detection.
audienceIntro: This course is designed for professionals responsible for operating, governing, evaluating, or implementing digital public procurement workflows, including in donor-funded procurement environments.
prerequisites: Working familiarity with public procurement processes is recommended. No coding or programming is required; exercises use process maps, procurement records, and Excel-based data checks.
